Both include required CAP4000 and lab 90010, total 13 credits within your 12–16 limit, and retain protected sections 90001 and 90002. Your CS3000 grade of B satisfies the alternative prerequisite; CS3500 is not additionally required. Neither has class overlaps or conflicts with your Tuesday/Thursday noon–5 p.m. work hours.

Plan A: CAP4000 meets Monday/Wednesday 8–9:15 a.m., concentrating those classes on days you already attend.
Plan B: CAP4000 meets Tuesday/Thursday 10–11:40 a.m., avoiding 8 a.m. starts but leaving only 20 minutes before work. Consider travel time.

Both have lab Thursday 5:30–6:20 p.m., 30 minutes after work. Neither fully meets your afternoon preference, which is a preference rather than a hard constraint. I favor B if the travel time works.

Both would replace elective 90003 if registered.
